title: Dispatch: contract-review corrections - one obligation per clause, base requirements, evidence binding (attempt 4)
description:
Contract-grounded fresh full review of PR #475 at 1b33b18 returned nine P1 and one
P2. Supervisor spot-confirmed the most structural ones. Pre-contract findings
are superseded — do NOT re-litigate real pack-driven execution, SRD enumeration,
importer migration, or engine certification; the contract defers all of those.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/adr/0020-source-clause-semantic-ir-and-completeness-contracts.md
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/types.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/contracts.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/obligations.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/index.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrContracts.test.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrObligations.test.ts

=== SUPERVISOR ARCHITECTURE DECISION — READ BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE ===
Finding 4 offers two routes. TAKE THE SECOND: enforce ONE OBLIGATION PER CLAUSE
as an invariant.

Rationale: the clause IS the unit of one source obligation. A single obligation
may carry MANY FACETS (save + duration + repeat-check + termination from one
source sentence). Where a source sentence carries genuinely separable mechanics,
it decomposes into multiple CLAUSES, each with its own obligation and its own
projection. This dissolves the whole class of defects in findings 4 and 7:
  * two duration obligations can no longer share one duration atom;
  * negative facets become coherent — 'save-without-damage' meaning 'this
    clause's damage is empty' is exactly right when the clause is that single
    obligation;
  * option-local mechanics cannot be hoisted, because hoisting would put two
    obligations on one clause, which now fails validation.
Enforce it in the evaluator and registry, document it in ADR 0020 as the
load-bearing invariant, and add tests that a clause claiming two obligations
fails closed. Retain field-count multiplicity WITHIN a facet (two saves in one
clause).

=== F1 (P1) CANONICAL BASE REQUIREMENTS ARE GONE — contracts.ts:111 ===
The published contract makes identity, sourceSpans, provenance, semanticOwner
and recordOwner UNREMOVABLE canonical requirements. The facet re-architecture
deleted BASE_REQUIREMENTS entirely; FACET_REQUIREMENTS holds only facet rules
and the evaluator never validates identity/provenance/ownership. A generated
clause with empty identity or owner evaluates semantically complete. Affects
every facet and all 15 families.
FIX: reinstate executable canonical base requirements that apply to EVERY
obligation and cannot be removed or overridden, plus an adversarial matrix that
removes or corrupts each base field in turn.

=== F2 (P1) SPECIALIZED FACETS ARE NOT CLOSED UNDER THEIR BASE — contracts.ts:115 ===
'save-with-damage' requires only a damage atom, not a save, so saves:[] plus one
damage certifies. Same for save-without-damage, save-with-alternate-outcomes,
attack-with-one-damage-mode, attack-with-conditional-alternatives,
resource-with-reset, and effect-without-lifecycle.
FIX: define ENFORCED facet implications (specialized implies its base mechanic)
or make each specialized facet self-contained. Add GENERATED removal tests for
every specialized facet — remove the base atom, assert incomplete.

=== F3 (P1) FACET VOCABULARY CANNOT EXPRESS THE CONTRACT'S TIMING — types.ts:80 ===
The contract assigns duration, recurrence, repeatChecks, immunityWindows and
termination to this PR, required exactly when an obligation declares them. There
is no generic recurrence facet and no immunity-window facet, so an authoritative
obligation cannot state them without a caller-side extension. Cross-kind gap for
spells, creature entries, hazards, features, magic items.
FIX: add canonical facets and predicates for recurrence and immunity windows,
with permanent sibling coverage.

=== F5 (P1) ALTERNATIVES PROVE NOTHING — contracts.ts:427 ===
The check only requires each alternative to name SOME existing alternative, so
A<->B plus C->A passes though B and C may overlap, and the committed test
permits every clauseIds list to be empty. Branch predicates count shells without
proving a source-backed outcome or condition.
FIX: validate the exclusion GRAPH (symmetry and partition), bind branches and
alternatives to projected atom identities, and add asymmetric, partially
connected, empty-binding and cross-kind regression cases.

=== F6 (P1) OBLIGATION IDENTITY IS NOT TIED TO ITS EVIDENCE — obligations.ts:104 ===
Validation checks only the obl: shape and that the terminal facet appears in
requiredFacets. It never verifies the ID's sourceRef/locator against the
obligation's source-span or authoritative-input evidence. Tests append synthetic
::index suffixes to the ID locator while keeping a DIFFERENT evidence locator,
and two same-facet obligations at one locator collide.
FIX: define a stable source-derived occurrence/clause locator so repeated
clauses at one anchor are distinguishable, and validate EVERY identity component
against origin-appropriate evidence. Reject synthetic locator divergence.

=== F7 (P1) CLOSURE BYPASSES ITS SCOPE AND CROSSES RECORDS — obligations.ts:263 ===
evaluateObligationClosure accepts any structurally shaped ObligationScope and
never requires createObligationScope, so a selectively omitted membership
returns a false-green empty closure. It also never checks
clause.recordOwner.family/key against the scope, so another record's clause can
satisfy this scope. T1/T7 only cover the constructor path.
FIX: consume an OPAQUE validated scope (brand it so a raw object literal cannot
be passed), validate applicability evidence, enforce exact family+record owner
matching, report unexpected claims, and add bypass / wrong-family / wrong-record
tests.

=== F8 (P1) AUDIT-ONLY EVIDENCE SATISFIES CAPTURED — contracts.ts:516 ===
The ADR says CAPTURED requires source-span or authoritative-input evidence, but
the loop accepts ANY registry evidence kind when the injected resolver returns
resolved. Since audit-finding origin is valid with only audit-finding evidence,
a KNOWN MISSING source clause can become captured and therefore semantically
complete.
FIX: restrict CAPTURED satisfaction to source-span or authoritative-input
evidence tied to that obligation. audit-finding and known-missing-source-clause
evidence IDENTIFY a gap; they must never close one. Add audit-only and
known-missing fail-closed tests.

=== F9 (P1) THE ENGINE-CAPABILITY CONTRACT IS NOT ENCODED — types.ts:375 ===
'export type EngineCapability = string' — any string. The contract requires
qualified engine:F1..engine:F10 owned through the eshyra-olc5 family epics, yet
committed tests use engine:save / eshyra-cap-save and an injected resolver
certifies them. Separately, ClauseReadinessEvidence.supported is never consumed,
so stored evidence can drift from requiredEngineCapabilities.
FIX: encode the closed identity shape and validate it; reconcile the two
capability-evidence surfaces so they cannot diverge; test unqualified,
wrong-owner, stale and mismatched references. This does NOT require real
execution — the contract defers that.

=== F10 (P2) THE VALIDATED REGISTRY IS MUTABLE — obligations.ts:176 ===
Records are shallow-frozen; evidence arrays, requiredFacets and nested evidence
objects are not, and scope applicability/evidence are retained by reference.
FIX: deep-copy and deep-freeze validated artifacts, or encapsulate them behind
immutable accessors. Add mutation-attempt regression tests.

=== ADR 0020 ===
Update it for the one-obligation-per-clause invariant, the base requirements,
facet implications, the recurrence/immunity facets, the identity-to-evidence
binding, opaque scopes, the CAPTURED restriction, and the capability identity.

CROSS-PR HONESTY: the ADR currently claims a shared identity with #476/#477 that
does not mechanically exist — #476 uses MembershipIdentity{recordKey, clauseId?,
path?, sourceSpan?} with no obligationId, and #477 accepts a broad obl:::
string. Do NOT overclaim. State precisely what is shared today, what is not, and
that validated adapters or parity tests are required before this is treated as
an integration boundary. A supervisor correction to #477's identity validation
is already in flight.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Design/type-contract
scope only — no importer, projector, pack regeneration, or engine registry
implementation. Edit only the files above; do not touch package.json,
internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/CI file. Do not
modify any bead but your own; no bd dolt push; no push, PR comment, or merge.
Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• One-obligation-per-clause is enforced and documented as the load-bearing invariant; a clause claiming two obligations fails closed.
• Canonical base requirements are executable, unremovable, and covered by an adversarial removal matrix.
• Specialized facets imply their base mechanic, with generated removal tests for every specialized facet.
• Recurrence and immunity-window facets exist with sibling coverage.
• Alternatives validate the exclusion graph and bind to projected atom identities; branches prove source-backed outcomes.
• Obligation identity components are validated against origin-appropriate evidence; repeated clauses at one anchor are distinguishable; synthetic locator divergence is rejected.
• Closure consumes an opaque validated scope and enforces exact family+record ownership; bypass and wrong-record tests exist.
• CAPTURED is satisfiable only by source-span or authoritative-input evidence; audit-only and known-missing fail closed.
• EngineCapability is a validated closed identity; the two capability-evidence surfaces are reconciled.
• Validated registry and scope are deep-frozen with mutation-attempt tests.
• ADR 0020 states the real cross-PR position without overclaiming.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
notes: Completion report: re-architected the owned clause-IR contract boundary. Enforced exactly one source obligation per clause while retaining multi-facet obligations; restored immutable canonical base requirements; added specialized-facet implications; added recurrence and immunity-window facets; validated alternative exclusion partitions, projected-atom bindings, and source-backed branch bindings; bound obligation identity components and repeated occurrence locators to origin-appropriate evidence; made scopes opaque/branded and exact-family/record closure reject unexpected claims; restricted CAPTURED to source-span/authoritative-input evidence; closed EngineCapability to engine:F1..F10 with eshyra-olc5 ownership and reconciled capability evidence; deep-copied/deep-froze registries and scopes; expanded adversarial tests and corrected ADR 0020 cross-PR honesty. Decision disagreement: none. Obligations not satisfiable in this bead: real PR #476/#477 validated adapters/parity, the production capability ledger/engine registry, importer migration, source census, pack regeneration, discovery index, and engine certification remain explicitly deferred; follow-up eshyra-gvzx tracks the cross-PR adapter/parity work. Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed (264 test files, 4734 passed, 19 skipped).
